title: UMD CI critique T2: SDK-surface mismatch cluster + gate-weakening diff verified
body: Critique research for ADVERSARIAL-universal-media-decomposer-ci-repair.md (T2 of 8) complete. Key findings: (1) Hatchet V1 migration guide documents AdminClient removal + `runs.create` surface; code's `_SDKSubmissionShim`/`_real_submit_workflow_run` calls `runs.admin_client().run_workflow(name, json_string)` — unvalidated, likely mismatched. (2) V1 SDK task signature is `(input, context)`; `_make_handler` handler takes one `payload` arg and indexes `payload["input"]["manifest"]` — EmptyModel default input validator breaks this on first live dispatch. (3) hatchet-lite official compose gRPC port is 7077, not the hardcoded 7070 in cli.py/_real_client(). (4) The UNCOMMITTED validation.yml working-tree diff IS the gate weakening (UMD_VALIDATE_LIVE_WORKER opt-in default off, db-api-only); committed HEAD a6b1a62 was fail-closed full-stack — the weakening has never run in CI. (5) debugger report exists untracked on disk (186 lines) — T1's missing-artifact note is stale. (6) python-multipart pin, ffmpeg absence, PGDG client-17, ghcr sub-path images all verified correct. Verdicts: A/B/C SURVIVE-WITH-CONDITIONS, D DEAD standalone (topology skew + lite gRPC port divergence).
